metrics.label: Points
metrics.desc: Points won per match. The outcome, not a process — which is why it is never weighted. A side's points in the first half of a season predict its second half at 0.59; the process metrics here manage 0.78.

metrics.label: Goal difference
metrics.desc: Goals scored minus conceded, per match.

metrics.label: Reaches the box
metrics.desc: Open-play entries into the penalty area — a completed pass in, or a carry in. The single best predictor in the bank of what a side wins next (0.76 against future points).

metrics.label: Makes big chances
metrics.desc: Chances Opta rates as big, from open play.

metrics.label: Shoots
metrics.desc: Shots from open play. Penalties excluded entirely — they are awarded rather than created.

metrics.label: Reaches the final third
metrics.desc: Completed passes crossing into the final third, open play.

metrics.label: Progresses it
metrics.desc: Completed open-play passes that move the ball meaningfully up the pitch.

metrics.label: Set-piece chances
metrics.desc: Big chances created from corners, free kicks and long throws. A separate capability from open-play creation and coached separately.

metrics.label: Set-piece shots
metrics.desc: Shots from a set piece.

metrics.label: Set-piece chances conceded
metrics.desc: Big chances given away from set pieces — defending them is its own skill.

metrics.label: Set-piece shots conceded
metrics.desc: Shots conceded from a set piece.

metrics.label: Box entries conceded
metrics.desc: Open-play entries into their own area.

metrics.label: Big chances conceded
metrics.desc: Big chances given away in open play.

metrics.label: Shots conceded
metrics.desc: Open-play shots faced.

metrics.label: Keeps the ball
metrics.desc: Share of the match's touches.

metrics.label: Goes long
metrics.desc: Share of passes longer than a third of the pitch.

metrics.label: Tempo
metrics.desc: Passes attempted per minute of their own possession. Not patience — a direct side records few of these because the ball is in the air.

metrics.label: Plays wide
metrics.desc: Share of touches in the two touchline channels.

metrics.label: Builds from the back
metrics.desc: Share of passes starting in their own third. Low means a side that is rarely IN its own third, not one that bypasses it.

metrics.label: Enters by crossing
metrics.desc: Of everything reaching the box, the share arriving as a cross.

metrics.label: Defends high
metrics.desc: Average pitch position of their defensive actions, 0 their own goal line.

metrics.label: Lets them pass
metrics.desc: Opponent passes allowed per defensive action in the opponent's two thirds. Low is an intense press; high is a side that sits off.

metrics.label: Wins it back high
metrics.desc: Share of their recoveries made in the final third.
